name: Spiraclethemes Site Library
author: spiraclethemes

sections.description:
A plugin by Spiracle Themes that adds one-click demo import, theme customization, starter templates, and page builder support to its free themes.

How to use this Spiraclethemes site library?

  1. While installing free themes by Spiraclethemes, kindly install & activate our plugin “Spiraclethemes Site Library” or do this manually.
  2. To import demo content, go to Appearance > Import Demo Data.
  3. Preview and select your desired demo, then click the import button.
  4. Contact Spiraclethemes support at http://support.spiraclethemes.com/ for assistance.

sections.installation:
*** From your WordPress dashboard ***

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’,
  2. Search for ‘Spiraclethemes Site Library’ and install the plugin.
  3. Activate ‘Spiraclethemes Site Library’ from your Plugins page.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

No, this plugin works only with themes developed by Spiraclethemes.

How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team helps validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
